missingParameters.mapping: Inherited Circular parameter has no effect on Switch
missingParameters.rationale: Switch overrides GetClasses without including Checkbox's circular class, so the inherited parameter is present in the CLR surface but not applied by the current component.
missingParameters.followUp: Remediate or explicitly deprecate through #435; do not silently count inherited parameters as supported.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited Size parameter has no effect on Switch
missingParameters.rationale: Switch overrides GetClasses without adding the inherited Checkbox size class, and fluent-switch has no size attribute in the pinned CEM.
missingParameters.followUp: Remediate or explicitly deprecate through #435 after the component API/design decision.

missingParameters.mapping: Declared Step parameter has no effective source behavior
missingParameters.rationale: The current implementation records the parameter but does not apply it to numeric parsing, increment/decrement behavior or the rendered input. This is a source-confirmed owner issue, not a request to change product code in #552.
missingParameters.followUp: Track/remediate through #433 after its design/API gate; add a negative-control test proving Step affects the intended contract.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited BindValueEvent is not honored by SelectField
missingParameters.rationale: SelectField binds through an explicit @onchange handler rather than using BindValueEvent; the inherited parameter has no effect in the current source.
missingParameters.followUp: Resolve the inherited API contract through #437; test both change and input paths before deciding whether to remove or honor it.

missingParameters.mapping: Declared per-date CSS callback is not forwarded to DateFieldPicker
missingParameters.rationale: The current DateField source declares DateClass but never reads or passes it to the embedded picker; the public parameter has no effect.
missingParameters.followUp: Wire the callback into the picker or explicitly deprecate it through #438 after design/API review.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited BindValueEvent is not forwarded to the nested MaskedField
missingParameters.rationale: DateField binds CurrentValueAsString to a MaskedField component but does not pass its own BindValueEvent; the parent parameter has no effect on the visible input event.
missingParameters.followUp: Either forward the setting or explicitly remove/deprecate the inherited contract through #438 after API review.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited BindValueEvent is not forwarded to the nested MaskedField
missingParameters.rationale: TimeField binds CurrentValueAsString to a MaskedField component but does not pass its own BindValueEvent; the parent parameter has no effect on the visible input event.
missingParameters.followUp: Either forward the setting or explicitly remove/deprecate the inherited contract through #439 after API review.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited BindValueEvent is not used by MaskedField
missingParameters.rationale: MaskedField handles DOM input explicitly with @oninput and does not bind through BindValueEvent; changing this inherited parameter has no effect on the visible input.
missingParameters.followUp: Resolve the inherited contract through #440; retain input-event semantics if required by the mask engine.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited StartAddon is not rendered by OtpField
missingParameters.rationale: OtpField markup does not render StartAddon despite inheriting the parameter; the public property has no effect.
missingParameters.followUp: Either render the addon in the approved OTP composition or explicitly deprecate the inherited API through #441.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited EndAddon is not rendered by OtpField
missingParameters.rationale: OtpField markup does not render EndAddon despite inheriting the parameter; the public property has no effect.
missingParameters.followUp: Either render the addon in the approved OTP composition or explicitly deprecate the inherited API through #441.

missingParameters.mapping: Inherited Size is not applied by OtpField
missingParameters.rationale: OtpField.GetClasses emits only bui-otp-field and the markup has no size-class binding; changing the inherited Size parameter has no effect.
missingParameters.followUp: Define supported OTP sizing in the approved design/API or explicitly deprecate the inherited parameter through #441.

limitations: These dispositions are source-to-pinned-CEM research, not maintainer approval or proof runtime behavior is correct.
RenderFragment/EventCallback entries are declaration mappings; child-content rendering, DOM event ordering, keyboard/pointer operation and Blazor binding remain separate runtime gates.
This rollup does not certify exhaustive Bluent CSS properties, CSS parts/states, token relations, emitted DOM behavior or the full framework InputBase<TValue> surface.
Out-of-band rows are ledger entries, not unique API counts; shared InputBase<TValue> notes repeat in Waves B-D and require separate emitted-API/form validation.
All 18 families remain audited_gaps with approval pending and evidenceBundle null. No visual, behavior, accessibility, native OS/AT or Fluent parity acceptance is inferred.
